request.text: Can I pick up a new black 128 GB iPhone 15 at a specific Beirut branch? Tell me the price and whether that branch has it.

message:
Best lead: IT Promax lists a new black 128GB iPhone 15 for $690.00, with online stock marked “In stock, ready to ship.”
Its published location is Mar Elias, Beirut, Lebanon, but stock at that store and pickup availability are unconfirmed. I cannot confirm you can collect it there now.
iSTYLE lists the same configuration at $979.02, but it is out of stock online; new condition and branch stock were not confirmed.
Suggestion: confirm the exact black 128GB unit and pickup availability with IT Promax before travelling.
